description: Record one interview question and how the user performed. Call this after EVERY question-answer exchange in a mock interview — this is what powers cross-session memory of weaknesses. performance: 'strong' (clear, correct, justified), 'okay' (mostly right, some gaps), 'weak' (couldn't explain or wrong). Include the specific gap in notes when performance is weak or okay, e.g. 'could not explain why JWT is verified server-side'.

notes.description: Specific gap or strength observed; be concrete

performance.description: How the user performed on this question

question.description: The interview question that was asked

section_id.description: Section this question targeted, if any — weak performance raises its weakness_score
